name: Easy Beef Carpaccio With Arugula

ingredients.name: fresh baby arugula, washed and dried

instructions.primary_message: Wrap beef tenderloin in plastic wrap, and chill in freezer for 1 hour. Using a very sharp knife, cut beef across the grain into 1/8-inch-thick slices. Place slices between sheets of plastic wrap or wax paper and gently pound with the flat end of a meat pounder, or roll with a heavy rolling pin until paper-thin.
Arrange slices on 6 individual chilled plates. Add arugula to a bowl and toss with 4 tablespoons of olive oil and season with salt and pepper. Arrange arugula in a pile in the center of each plate.

Place remaining 4 tablespoons oil, lemon juice, mustard, egg yolk, salt and pepper in a 2-cup measure. Use an immersion blender to mix until thick. Drizzle mustard sauce around each plate avoiding arugula. Garnish plates with tomato quarters and serve immediately.

schema_metadata.keywords: beef, beef carpaccio, Italian, italian easy

description: Beef carpaccio is paper-thin slices of ultra-fresh raw beef garnished with arugula and drizzled with vinaigrette. It's a fabulous appetizer to serve when entertaining guests—it looks and tastes great and it's easy to prepare.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 1 hr 20 min.

Optional or for serving: 10 small tomatoes cut into quarters to garnish

Notes: For this dish it is best to use baby or wild arugula, but if this is not available, you can use mixed baby salad greens.
You can either drizzle your carpaccio dish with a lightly flavored mustard sauce as I have in my recipe, or choose to use a simple lemon vinaigrette. To create your vinaigrette, top your carpaccio with a squeeze of lemon, a drizzle of olive oil, and a sprinkle of salt and pepper.
author: Deborah Mele
